title: A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio
abstract: arXiv:2610.38252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Music audio generation spans instrumental clips, full songs with vocals, edits of existing recordings, and systems that play alongside a musician in real time. This monograph explains the methods behind these systems for readers familiar with neural-network training who are new to music generation. It introduces neural audio codecs and autoencoders, autoregressive and masked token models, diffusion and flow matching, sampling acceleration, and preference optimization in a shared notation. Worked examples connect training objectives and sampling procedures to published systems. The application sections relate the musical requirements of instrumental generation, songs, editing, and live performance to model design. Comparison tables record representations, methods, inputs, tasks, and release information documented in papers and official sources. Symbolic composition, speech, and sound effects are included where they connect to music audi

translated_title: 音乐音频生成模型教程
translated_abstract: 音乐音频生成涵盖了器乐片段、带人声的完整歌曲、对现有录音的编辑，以及与音乐家实时合奏的系统。本专著面向熟悉神经网络训练但不熟悉音乐生成的读者，解释了这些系统背后的方法。它以统一的符号体系介绍了神经音频编解码器与自编码器、自回归与掩码词元模型、扩散与流匹配、采样加速以及偏好优化。实例演示将训练目标和采样过程与已发表的系统联系起来。应用章节将器乐生成、歌曲、编辑和现场演奏的音乐需求与模型设计相关联。对比表格记录了论文和官方来源中记载的表示方法、方法、输入、任务和发布信息。在与音乐音频相关的部分，还涵盖了符号作曲、语音和音效等内容。
tldr: 本教程以统一符号体系系统介绍了音乐音频生成的核心技术（包括神经音频编解码器、自回归与掩码词元模型、扩散与流匹配、采样加速和偏好优化），并将这些方法与器乐生成、歌曲、编辑和实时演奏等实际应用需求紧密关联。
en_tdlr: This tutorial provides a unified introduction to generative models for music audio—including neural audio codecs, autoregressive and masked token models, diffusion and flow matching, sampling acceleration, and preference optimization—connecting these methods to real-world applications in instrumental generation, songs, editing, and live performance.
